using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Pragmatic.Composition;
using Pragmatic.Composition.Hosting;

namespace Pragmatic.Composition.Hosting;

public static class PragmaticApp
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Runs a web application with auto-discovered Pragmatic modules.
    /// </summary>
    public static async Task RunAsync(string[] args, 
                                      Action<IPragmaticBuilder>? configure = null)
    {
        var builder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);
        
        // SG defaults — auto-register infrastructure modules based on referenced assemblies
        global::TestAssembly.PragmaticHost.RegisterAllPragmaticServices(builder.Services, builder.Configuration);
        
        // Module strategy configuration — user overrides defaults via IPragmaticBuilder
        var pragmaticBuilder = new PragmaticBuilder(builder.Services, builder.Configuration, builder.Environment);
        configure?.Invoke(pragmaticBuilder);
        
        // Maintenance options — one instance for the always-wired 503 middleware and the startup-failure page
        global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Extensions.ServiceCollectionDescriptorExtensions.TryAddSingleton(builder.Services, pragmaticBuilder.Options.MaintenanceMode);
        
        // Aggregated host health (IHostStatus + IHostHealthContributor) — on unless DisableHealthEndpoint()
        if (pragmaticBuilder.Options.Health.Enabled)
        {
            var _healthChecks = global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.HealthCheckServiceCollectionExtensions.AddHealthChecks(builder.Services);
            global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.HealthChecksBuilderAddCheckExtensions.AddCheck<global::Pragmatic.Composition.ControlPlane.ControlPlaneHealthCheck>(_healthChecks, "pragmatic-host");
        }
        
        // Bind telemetry options from configuration (appsettings.json "Telemetry" section)
        builder.Configuration.GetSection("Telemetry").Bind(pragmaticBuilder.Options.Telemetry);
        
        // OpenTelemetry — auto-configured, opt-out via options.Telemetry.Enabled = false
        global::Pragmatic.Composition.Hosting.PragmaticTelemetry.AddPragmaticTelemetry(builder.Services, pragmaticBuilder.Options.Telemetry, builder.Environment.IsDevelopment());
        
        // Pragmatic sensible defaults: JSON serialization (pipeline steps can override)
        // The TypeInfoResolver comes from the shared PragmaticJsonOptions seam (DI-injected so
        // host-registered source-generated contexts + the AOT fallback opt-out apply here too).
        global::Pragmatic.Serialization.PragmaticJsonServiceCollectionExtensions.AddPragmaticJson(builder.Services);
        builder.Services.AddOptions<global::Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http.Json.JsonOptions>()
            .Configure<global::Pragmatic.Serialization.PragmaticJsonOptions>((jsonOptions, pragmaticJson) =>
            {
                jsonOptions.SerializerOptions.PropertyNamingPolicy = System.Text.Json.JsonNamingPolicy.CamelCase;
                jsonOptions.SerializerOptions.DefaultIgnoreCondition = System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonIgnoreCondition.WhenWritingNull;
                jsonOptions.SerializerOptions.Converters.Add(new System.Text.Json.Serialization.JsonStringEnumConverter());
                jsonOptions.SerializerOptions.ReferenceHandler = System.Text.Json.Serialization.ReferenceHandler.IgnoreCycles;
                
                var resolver = pragmaticJson.Build().TypeInfoResolver;
                if (resolver is not null)
                {
                    jsonOptions.SerializerOptions.TypeInfoResolver = resolver;
                }
                
                // What this configuration wrote, so a generated response writer is used only while it still holds:
                // anything configured after this line that changes the bytes sends responses back to the serializer.
                global::Pragmatic.Serialization.GeneratedJsonDefaults.Mark(
                    jsonOptions.SerializerOptions, pragmaticJson,
                    excludesInfrastructure: false);
            });
        
        // Call ConfigureServices on all pipeline steps (business wiring)
        global::TestAssembly.PragmaticHost.CallConfigureServices(builder.Services, builder.Configuration, builder.Environment);
        
        // Register [ServiceFactory] classes and their [Factory] methods
        global::TestAssembly.PragmaticServiceFactories.AddPragmaticServiceFactories(builder.Services);
        
        var app = builder.Build();
        
        // Map infrastructure exceptions to problem responses (optimistic-concurrency conflict → 409)
        // as the outermost middleware, before any business pipeline or endpoint runs.
        app.UsePragmaticExceptionMapping();
        
        // Maintenance mode opt-out: tests set Pragmatic:MaintenanceMode:EnableOnStartupFailure=false via config
        var maintenanceEnabled = pragmaticBuilder.Options.MaintenanceMode.EnableOnStartupFailure
            && !string.Equals(builder.Configuration["Pragmatic:MaintenanceMode:EnableOnStartupFailure"], "false", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
        
        try
        {
            // Database initialization (migrations/EnsureCreated) — inside the try so a startup failure shows the maintenance page
            // No databases configured — skip initialization
            
            // Configure all middleware pipelines
            global::TestAssembly.PragmaticHost.ConfigurePipeline(app);
            
            // Map all discovered endpoints
            global::TestAssembly.PragmaticHost.MapAllEndpoints(app);
            
            // Module endpoint hooks (SignalR hubs, gRPC services, etc.)
            foreach (var configurator in app.Services.GetServices<global::Pragmatic.Composition.IEndpointRouteBuilderConfigurator>())
                configurator.Configure(app);
            
            // Aggregated host health endpoint — mapped unless the application disabled it or owns the route
            global::Pragmatic.Composition.Hosting.HealthEndpointMapper.Map(app, pragmaticBuilder.Options.Health);
            
            // Endpoints that require authorization need an authentication method in this environment
            await global::Pragmatic.Composition.Hosting.AuthenticationRequirement.VerifyAsync(app, app.Environment);
            
            await app.RunAsync();
        }
        catch (Exception ex) when (maintenanceEnabled)
        {
            // Enter maintenance mode — build a fresh minimal app since the original may be disposed.
            // From the same args: the page must answer where the host was told to listen (--urls).
            var maintenanceBuilder = WebApplication.CreateBuilder(args);
            var maintenanceApp = maintenanceBuilder.Build();
            var maintenance = new MaintenanceMode(ex, pragmaticBuilder.Options.MaintenanceMode, builder.Environment.IsDevelopment());
            maintenance.Configure(maintenanceApp);
            await maintenanceApp.RunAsync();
        }
    }
    
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Runs a background worker host with auto-discovered Pragmatic modules.
    /// </summary>
    public static async Task RunWorkerAsync(string[] args, 
                                            Action<IPragmaticBuilder>? configure = null)
    {
        var builder = Host.CreateApplicationBuilder(args);
        
        // SG defaults — auto-register infrastructure modules
        global::TestAssembly.PragmaticHost.RegisterAllPragmaticServices(builder.Services, builder.Configuration);
        
        // Module strategy configuration
        var pragmaticBuilder = new PragmaticBuilder(builder.Services, builder.Configuration, builder.Environment);
        configure?.Invoke(pragmaticBuilder);
        
        // Bind telemetry options from configuration (appsettings.json "Telemetry" section)
        builder.Configuration.GetSection("Telemetry").Bind(pragmaticBuilder.Options.Telemetry);
        
        // OpenTelemetry — auto-configured, opt-out via options.Telemetry.Enabled = false
        global::Pragmatic.Composition.Hosting.PragmaticTelemetry.AddPragmaticTelemetry(builder.Services, pragmaticBuilder.Options.Telemetry, builder.Environment.IsDevelopment());
        
        // Call ConfigureServices on all pipeline steps (business wiring)
        global::TestAssembly.PragmaticHost.CallConfigureServices(builder.Services, builder.Configuration, builder.Environment);
        
        // Register [ServiceFactory] classes and their [Factory] methods
        global::TestAssembly.PragmaticServiceFactories.AddPragmaticServiceFactories(builder.Services);
        
        var host = builder.Build();
        
        await host.RunAsync();
    }
    
}

using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Configuration;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;
using Pragmatic.Composition.Abstractions;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.RateLimiting;
using Pragmatic.Events.Extensions;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Routing;
using Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;

namespace TestAssembly;

internal static class PragmaticHost
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Registers all DomainAction invokers, Mutation invokers, and boundary interfaces from discovered modules.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">The service collection.</param>
    /// <returns>The service collection for chaining.</returns>
    internal static IServiceCollection RegisterAllDomainActions(this IServiceCollection services)
    {
        // No domain modules discovered
        return services;
    }
    
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Registers all IStartupStep implementations.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">The service collection.</param>
    /// <returns>The service collection for chaining.</returns>
    internal static IServiceCollection RegisterAllPipelineSteps(this IServiceCollection services)
    {
        // Local [StartupStep] classes
        services.AddSingleton<IStartupStep, global::TestApp.AuthSetup>();
        services.AddSingleton<IStartupStep, global::TestApp.CacheSetup>();
        services.AddSingleton<IStartupStep, global::TestApp.DatabaseSetup>();
        
        return services;
    }
    
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Registers all endpoint services from discovered assemblies.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">The service collection.</param>
    /// <returns>The service collection for chaining.</returns>
    internal static IServiceCollection RegisterAllEndpoints(this IServiceCollection services)
    {
        // No endpoint assemblies discovered
        return services;
    }
    
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Registers all Pragmatic services: infrastructure modules, actions, repositories, and startup steps.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="services">The service collection.</param>
    /// <param name="configuration">The application configuration.</param>
    /// <returns>The service collection for chaining.</returns>
    internal static IServiceCollection RegisterAllPragmaticServices(this IServiceCollection services, 
                                                                    IConfiguration configuration)
    {
        // Control plane host identity and status (NoOp default, replaced by UseAgent)
        services.AddSingleton<global::Pragmatic.ControlPlane.IHostIdentity>(new global::Pragmatic.Composition.ControlPlane.LocalHostIdentity(hostName: "TestAssembly"));
        services.AddSingleton<global::Pragmatic.Composition.ControlPlane.LocalHostStatus>();
        services.AddSingleton<global::Pragmatic.ControlPlane.IHostStatus>(sp => sp.GetRequiredService<global::Pragmatic.Composition.ControlPlane.LocalHostStatus>());
        services.AddSingleton<global::Pragmatic.ControlPlane.IControlPlane>(sp => new global::Pragmatic.Composition.ControlPlane.NoOpControlPlane(
            sp.GetRequiredService<global::Pragmatic.ControlPlane.IHostIdentity>(),
            sp.GetRequiredService<global::Pragmatic.ControlPlane.IHostStatus>()));
        // Cluster leadership — NoOp default (always-leader monolith), replaced by UseAgent's KV-lease election
        services.AddSingleton<global::Pragmatic.ControlPlane.IClusterLeadership, global::Pragmatic.Composition.ControlPlane.NoOpClusterLeadership>();
        // Maintenance mode — default singleton (replaced by UseMaintenanceMode if called).
        // Factory (not a bare instance) so the logger is injected and any DI-registered
        // IMaintenanceModeObserver is attached — a bare instance would leave the observers unreachable.
        global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Extensions.ServiceCollectionDescriptorExtensions.TryAddSingleton<global::Pragmatic.Maintenance.IMaintenanceMode>(services, static sp =>
        {
            var _maintenance = new global::Pragmatic.Composition.Hosting.MaintenanceModeService(
                global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.ServiceProviderServiceExtensions.GetService<global::Microsoft.Extensions.Logging.ILogger<global::Pragmatic.Composition.Hosting.MaintenanceModeService>>(sp));
            foreach (var _observer in global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.ServiceProviderServiceExtensions.GetServices<global::Pragmatic.Maintenance.IMaintenanceModeObserver>(sp))
                _maintenance.AddObserver(_observer);
            return _maintenance;
        }
        );
        // Maintenance 503 middleware (Order -100) — always wired, or an active maintenance flag lets traffic through
        services.AddSingleton<global::Pragmatic.Composition.Abstractions.IStartupStep, global::Pragmatic.Composition.Hosting.MaintenanceStep>();
        services.AddHostedService<global::Pragmatic.Composition.ControlPlane.HostStatusSyncService>();
        // Health aggregator — collects health reports from all IHostHealthContributor instances
        services.AddSingleton<global::Pragmatic.ControlPlane.IHostHealthAggregator, global::Pragmatic.Composition.ControlPlane.HostHealthAggregator>();
        // Command dispatcher + built-in handlers (maintenance, drain)
        services.AddSingleton<global::Pragmatic.ControlPlane.IHostCommandDispatcher, global::Pragmatic.Composition.ControlPlane.HostCommandDispatcher>();
        // Shared handle holder — thread-safe singleton owned by both maintenance command handlers
        services.AddSingleton<global::Pragmatic.Composition.ControlPlane.MaintenanceHandleHolder>();
        services.AddSingleton<global::Pragmatic.ControlPlane.IHostCommandHandler<global::Pragmatic.ControlPlane.EnterMaintenanceCommand>, global::Pragmatic.Composition.ControlPlane.MaintenanceCommandHandler>();
        services.AddSingleton<global::Pragmatic.ControlPlane.IHostCommandHandler<global::Pragmatic.ControlPlane.ExitMaintenanceCommand>, global::Pragmatic.Composition.ControlPlane.ExitMaintenanceCommandHandler>();
        services.AddSingleton<global::Pragmatic.ControlPlane.IHostCommandHandler<global::Pragmatic.ControlPlane.DrainCommand>, global::Pragmatic.Composition.ControlPlane.DrainCommandHandler>();
        // MigrateCommand handler — no-op-with-log unless a host migration coordinator is present
        services.AddSingleton<global::Pragmatic.ControlPlane.IHostCommandHandler<global::Pragmatic.ControlPlane.MigrateCommand>, global::Pragmatic.Composition.ControlPlane.MigrateCommandHandler>();
        
        // Domain event bus (in-memory) — publishers resolve it with or without handlers
        services.AddInMemoryDomainEvents();
        
        // Generated redaction maps ([NotLogged] / [PersonalData]) from discovered assemblies
        global::TestAssembly.Generated.TestAssemblyRedactionRegistrationExtensions.AddGeneratedRedactionMap(services);
        global::Pragmatic.Redaction.DeclaredRedactionServiceCollectionExtensions.AddDeclaredRedaction(services);
        
        // Startup steps
        services.RegisterAllPipelineSteps();
        
        return services;
    }
    
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Calls ConfigureServices on all discovered IStartupStep implementations.
    /// </summary>
    internal static void CallConfigureServices(IServiceCollection services, 
                                               IConfiguration configuration, 
                                               IHostEnvironment environment)
    {
        // Honor ConfigureServices for all discovered IStartupStep (host + NeedsStep + built-in + module), ordered by Order.
        using var _bootstrap = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        foreach (var startupStep in global::Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.ServiceProviderServiceExtensions.GetServices<IStartupStep>(_bootstrap).OrderBy(s => s.Order))
            startupStep.ConfigureServices(services, configuration, environment);
    }
    
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Configures all middleware from discovered IStartupStep implementations.
    /// </summary>
    internal static void ConfigurePipeline(IApplicationBuilder app)
    {
        var steps = app.ApplicationServices
            .GetServices<IStartupStep>()
            .OrderBy(s => s.Order)
            .ThenBy(s => s.GetType().FullName);
        
        foreach (var step in steps)
        {
            step.ConfigurePipeline(app);
        }
    }
    
    
    /// <summary>
    /// Maps all discovered endpoints to the application.
    /// </summary>
    /// <param name="endpoints">The endpoint route builder.</param>
    /// <returns>The endpoint route builder for chaining.</returns>
    internal static IEndpointRouteBuilder MapAllEndpoints(this IEndpointRouteBuilder endpoints)
    {
        // No endpoint assemblies discovered
        return endpoints;
    }
    
}
